title: My favourite season
instructions: Yuki en sevdiği mevsimi anlatıyor. Neden sevdiğine ve ne yaptığına dikkat et.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: Summer in my city is too hot and humid, and winter is grey and cold.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: In autumn, the weather is cool and the trees turn red and yellow.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: Every year, I go to the mountains with my friends to take photos of the leaves.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: I also love autumn food, especially sweet potatoes.

questions.prompt: What is summer like in her city?
questions.feedback: Yazın şehri çok sıcak ve nemli.
questions.evidence: Summer in my city is too hot and humid

questions.prompt: What does Yuki do every year?
options: She takes photos of the leaves in the mountains.
questions.feedback: Her yıl arkadaşlarıyla dağlara gidip yaprakların fotoğrafını çekiyor.
questions.evidence: to take photos of the leaves.
